socketUnlock.method: eligible through branch progression, then opened with a dedicated unlock item

stoneTypes.basic: Universal/basic stones created later for all branches. They provide generic numerical modifiers such as damage, critical chance, cooldown, MP cost, area or speed and apply to the currently active skill in the branch.
stoneTypes.elementalColored: Colored elemental stones tied to a magic element. They reuse former standalone spells or mechanics as effects, passives, procs or behavior modifiers for the currently active evolution. Fire stones modify Fire, Ice stones modify Ice, Lightning stones modify Lightning, etc.

uiDirection.layout: evolution path above/center, current-skill details/preview, five sockets along bottom

specialStoneCandidates.Burning: Applies a fire damage-over-time effect; adapts to the active fire evolution.
specialStoneCandidates.FireWall: Leaves persistent fire zones/trails depending on the active fire evolution.
specialStoneCandidates.ScortchedEarth: Creates scorched ground after impacts; scale/count adapts to the active fire evolution.
specialStoneCandidates.FireStorm: Adds a secondary area-fire burst or storm behavior to impacts.
specialStoneCandidates.FlameArt: Reserved legendary/special modifier; Zircon entry is not coded, so ORIGINS may define it freely.

fire.designNote: The five evolution stages are one evolving skill, not five simultaneously usable skills. Stones belong to the fire branch and remain equipped when the skill evolves.

specialStoneCandidates.FrozenEarth: Adds a forward ice-line or frozen-ground effect to the active ice evolution.
specialStoneCandidates.GreaterFrozenEarth: Upgrades the frozen-ground modifier into a wider three-line pattern.
specialStoneCandidates.FrostBite: Adds a delayed frost burst around the caster after a temporary buff/window.
specialStoneCandidates.IceAura: Adds a persistent ice field capable of repeatedly applying paralysis.
specialStoneCandidates.IceBreaker: Adds or strengthens an expanding radial ice burst around the caster.
specialStoneCandidates.FrozenDragon: Reserved as a powerful radial/final ice modifier or possible future evolution alternative.

ice.designNote: Provisional ORIGINS order: IceBolt -> IceBlades -> IceDragon -> IceStorm -> IceRain. IceRain remains the proposed final stage for now; FrozenDragon is kept outside the chain as a candidate special modifier or alternate final evolution.

stages.behavior: ORIGINS evolution of ThunderBolt: strikes up to 3 valid targets when available; if only one target is available, only one bolt is shown and applied. This evolution requires its own new ORIGINS spell name.
Final active evolution: lightning propagates through nearby targets.

specialStoneCandidates.Shocked: Real Zircon lightning augmentation. Adds a chance for lightning attacks to inflict Shock based on the augment level/power.
specialStoneCandidates.LightningBeam: Candidate colored modifier that can add a line/beam follow-up or directional lightning effect to the current active evolution.
specialStoneCandidates.ThunderStrike: Candidate colored proc/passive that can call extra lightning strikes around the caster or targets.
specialStoneCandidates.LightningStrike: Candidate advanced chaining/rebound proc that can jump additional times between nearby monsters.
specialStoneCandidates.ElectricShock: Candidate electrical-control stone. Zircon uses it for shock/control/taming; ORIGINS should reuse only the control concept, not the pet-taming behavior by default.

lightning.designNote: Locked direction: LightningBall -> ThunderBolt -> new named multi-target ThunderBolt evolution (name pending, up to 3 targets) -> LightningWave -> ChainLightning. Main chain prioritizes active attacks; rebound, shock and control mechanics are moved toward colored lightning stones/passives.

specialStoneCandidates.Tornado: Candidate colored wind stone or summon-effect modifier based on Zircon's temporary tornado summon behavior.
specialStoneCandidates.Storm: Candidate legendary wind stone/effect. Zircon defines it as Wind but leaves the skill incomplete, so ORIGINS can define its final behavior.
specialStoneCandidates.Repulsion: Wind control modifier: pushes enemies away from the caster or from impact zones depending on the active wind evolution.

wind.designNote: Locked ORIGINS wind evolution: GustBlast -> Cyclone -> BlowEarth -> DragonTornado -> Tempest. Tornado, Storm and Repulsion are reserved for colored wind stones/effects rather than the active evolution chain.

Renounce.zirconBehavior: Trades HealthPercent for additional MCPercent for a timed duration; also grants passive MCPercent scaling with level.

reservedForLater.JudgementOfHeaven: Do not include for now; revisit later if a suitable buff/proc role is needed.
reservedForLater.ElementalHurricane: Do not include in Illusion. Reserve for a later system, potentially as a permanent elemental buff/state or another long-term progression mechanic.
reservedForLater.MirrorImage: Not included in the current utility set; revisit later if an illusion/summon mechanic is wanted.
